title: VIXEN standalone configure should provision or derive UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: A fresh standalone VIXEN sanitizer configure/build failed because VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt requires UNDERTOW_ROOT; the queued witness had to inject env UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/lockcpusan manually. Consolidate the consumer setup so the facade/tooling derives or validates the matching Undertow root automatically. Tier: haiku; effort: S.

title: Queued detached witness recipe should encode setsid
body: The first detached sanitizer queue launches used nohup bash without setsid and exited immediately with empty logs; every long witness then had to be relaunched as nohup setsid bash ... < /dev/null > log 2>&1 &. Consolidate the documented runner/launcher contract so detached queued jobs survive the shell without lane-specific recovery. Tier: haiku; effort: S.

title: VIXEN ASan+UBSan Cornell link needs a supported glslang sanitizer configuration
body: A fresh ASan+UBSan Cornell target build reached final link but failed because the provisioned Vulkan SDK glslang 16.3 libraries do not provide the glslang TShader/TProgram RTTI symbols requested by the instrumented ShaderCompiler object. The brief's permitted ASan-only GPU route required a separate reconfigure and full rebuild before the Cornell witness could run. Consolidate sanitizer presets/toolchain compatibility so the documented sanitizer configuration either links or selects the supported sanitizer combination automatically.
